description: Returns key timings and locations of aircraft takeoffs and landings alongside all primary flight, aircraft, and operator information. Both real-time and historical data are available. Data is available starting from 2024-04-07 and will be extended further in the near future. IMPORTANT: flight_datetime_from and flight_datetime_to are required, and at least one additional search parameter (other than sort and limit) should be provided.

airports.description: Airports (IATA/ICAO/ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or countries. Use format: [direction:]<code>.

flight_datetime_from.description: Start datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Requires flight_datetime_to. Cannot be used with flight_ids. Maximum query range is 14 days.

flight_datetime_to.description: End datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Requires flight_datetime_from. Cannot be used with flight_ids. Maximum query range is 14 days.

limit.description: Limit of results. Recommended, unless needed. Max 20000.

operating_as.description: Aircraft operating under an airline's call sign (ICAO code, comma-separated, max 15).

painted_as.description: Aircraft painted in an airline's livery (ICAO code, comma-separated, max 15).

routes.description: Flights between airports/countries (e.g., SE-US, ESSA-JFK). Max 15.

name: get_flight_summary_light
